info.name: IoT Smart Home API - SensoSynch Full TC01-TC17
info.description: Separate Full edition; originals/Examples preserved. TC04 Valid, TC05 Invalid, TC06 Missing per user. All real hardware POSTs locked by default. TC15 is read-only but kept between TC14 and TC16 to preserve numerical order and actual action-id dependency. Do not export private environment values.

request.description: Public health without token. Expected HTTP 200. Source: existing src/routes/ and middleware; no hardware command is published by this validation/read request.

Incorrect login is rejected. Expected HTTP 401. Source: existing src/routes/ and middleware; no hardware command is published by this validation/read request.
Protected GET with valid token. Expected HTTP 200. Source: existing src/routes/ and middleware; no hardware command is published by this validation/read request.
Protected GET with fake token. Expected HTTP 401. Source: existing src/routes/ and middleware; no hardware command is published by this validation/read request.
Protected GET without token. Expected HTTP 401. Source: existing src/routes/ and middleware; no hardware command is published by this validation/read request.
Real latest MySQL rows. Null means no stored sample; it does not mean zero or fresh ESP32 data. Light remains ADC.

item.name: Hardware Control - Manual
item.description: TC12/13/14/16/17 are locked; TC15 is a read-only dependent result lookup. Use Send for deliberate control, never full Runner with an unlocked request.

request.description: MANUAL ONLY. GPIO 25. Default locked: Collection Runner must not actuate hardware. To manually Send ONE request, change hardwareRequestLocked to false in its pre-request script and set manual_confirmation=TC12, control_action=ON or OFF. Restore true afterwards. HTTP 202 is admission, not SUCCESS. Poll actual action id and verify final history/device state.

exec: pm.variables.set('blocked_TC12','Set manual_confirmation=TC12 for one deliberate Send');pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.test('202 command admitted, not proof of LED success',()=>{

pm.test('Final Action History record matches',()=>{pm.expect(err).to.eql(null);pm.expect(history.code).to.eql(200);const row=history.json().content.find(r=>r.id==='#'+j.id);pm.expect(row,'record by command id').to.exist;pm.expect(row.status).to.eql(result.status);pm.expect(row.action).to.eql(j.action);pm.expect(row.reason).to.eql(result.reason);});
